title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 26: the basket of first fruits, the confession before Yahweh, and the year of tithing.

questions.text: In what were the first fruits of the ground to be carried?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to put the first of the fruit in a basket and go to the place Yahweh would choose.

answers.text: In a basket
In a clay jar
In a leather bag
On a cart

questions.text: What did the priest do with the basket?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the priest shall take the basket and set it down before Yahweh your God's altar.

answers.text: He gave it back to the worshiper
He shared it with the elders
He burned it on the altar
He set it down before Yahweh's altar

questions.text: How does the worshiper describe his father in verse 5?
questions.explanation: He says: "My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number."

answers.text: A prince from the house of the king of Egypt
A Syrian ready to perish
A Moabite shepherd
A Canaanite king

questions.text: According to verse 5, what did the father become in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that there he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

answers.text: A small tribe scattered among the cities of Egypt
A nation of priests
A people without a home
A great, mighty and populous nation

questions.text: With what did Yahweh bring Israel out of Egypt, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought them out with a mighty hand, an outstretched arm, great terror, signs and wonders.

answers.text: A mighty hand and an outstretched arm
A great army of horsemen
The help of the Egyptian king
Ships across the sea

questions.text: How is the land Yahweh gave them described in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 calls it "a land flowing with milk and honey."

answers.text: A land flowing with wine and oil
A land full of gold and silver
A land flowing with milk and honey
A land of wheat and figs

questions.text: Which year is called the year of tithing?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 speaks of the tithe of the increase "in the third year, which is the year of tithing."

answers.text: The first year
The third year
The fifth year
The seventh year

questions.text: To whom was the tithe of the year of tithing to be given?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so they may eat within the gates and be filled.

answers.text: The Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow
The king and all of his officers and servants
The priests who serve at the place Yahweh chooses
The elders and the judges of the city

questions.text: What does the worshiper declare he has NOT done with the holy things?
questions.explanation: He says he has put them out of his house and given them to the Levite and the widow, but: "I have not eaten of it in my mourning."

answers.text: Given it to the Levite
Eaten of it in his mourning
Put it out of his house
Given it to the widow

questions.text: What has Yahweh declared Israel to be, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says Yahweh has declared today that they are a people for his own possession.

answers.text: A nation of servants to all the peoples around them
A people without a land
A people for his own possession
A small and weak tribe
